instruction:
Fix `plugins/catalog/src/components/CatalogEntityPage/useEntityFromUrl.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. CI=true yarn test plugins/catalog: 'CatalogEntityPage › redirects an old ref to the current entity and shows a dismissible notice' fails: findByText(/This entity was renamed from component:default.*old-name/) not found; the rendered notice reads 'This entity was renamed from component:default/new-name.' (redirect itself works: path /catalog/default/component/new-name/docs?view=table). Cause in this hook (lines 76-104): after the first navigate(), the route params change to new-name while `value.renamedTo` is still the stale result, so the redirect effect (deps include kind/namespace/name) fires a second time and navigates again with `renamedFromEntityRef: stringifyEntityRef({ kind, namespace, name })` built from the NEW params, overwriting the old ref in router state (and defeating the one-hop loop guard). Fix: capture the former ref inside the async loader (return `{ renamedTo, formerRef: stringifyEntityRef({ kind, namespace, name }) }` from the same call that looked it up), use `value.formerRef` for the state, and only navigate when the current URL ref still equals that former ref (or no renamedFromEntityRef is in location.state), so the effect cannot navigate twice. Keep the rest of the hook (sub-path, search, hash, replace: true) unchanged.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "plugins/catalog/src/components/CatalogEntityPage/useEntityFromUrl.ts", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "plugins/catalog/src/components/CatalogEntityPage/useEntityFromUrl.ts", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
